segments.text: Now train on B alone, and A's prediction gets worse. Instead, replay an example from task A. In this toy, that helps retain both tasks. Both paths use equal example counts, but replay needs memory and sees fewer new examples.
segments.visual: Follow the two existing SGD trajectories. Reveal replay tradeoff beside equal presentation count.

segments.text: Now consider which memory to replay. The hardest example right now is different from the one most harmed by a hypothetical update. That update is only used to score the memories, then discarded.
segments.visual: Clear geometry, introduce current-loss axis, then signed change axis. Highlight hard-now before threatened-next.
